owner_path: POST /api/deployment/sagas/{saga_id}/retire (DEPLOYMENT-SAGA-RETIRE-COMMAND-20261013); retired sagas classified from status=retired

scope_rule.accepted: every active release case except this run's case is retired
scope_rule.compensated: only this run's case is retired; no other case is touched; served case never inferred from recency

workflow.admit_job_step: Retire non-served dev paper release cases (accepted or compensated)
workflow.deploy_job_step: Retire this run's dev paper release case after deploy compensation

dry_run: docker exec -i pantheon-operator-bff-1 python - --dry-run --outcome accepted < scripts/retire_dev_paper_release_cases.py
limitation: hosted behaviour of the retire action on real sagas is first exercised by the next Root; a deploy-job retire runs after the compensation lease is released
